provider_runs_block_range.name: provider_runs_block_range
provider_runs_block_range.value: "provider_runs"."block_from" is null or "provider_runs"."block_to" is null or "provider_runs"."block_from" <= "provider_runs"."block_to"

token_snapshots_pct_range.name: token_snapshots_pct_range
token_snapshots_pct_range.value:
("token_snapshots"."top10_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top10_pct" between 0 and 100)
        and ("token_snapshots"."top50_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top50_pct" between 0 and 100)

token_snapshots_top10_within_top50.name: token_snapshots_top10_within_top50
token_snapshots_top10_within_top50.value: "token_snapshots"."top10_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top50_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top10_pct" <= "token_snapshots"."top50_pct"

token_snapshots_counts_non_negative.name: token_snapshots_counts_non_negative
token_snapshots_counts_non_negative.value:
("token_snapshots"."holder_count" is null or "token_snapshots"."holder_count" >= 0)
        and ("token_snapshots"."tx_count_24h" is null or "token_snapshots"."tx_count_24h" >= 0)

evidence_fact_is_anchored.name: evidence_fact_is_anchored
evidence_fact_is_anchored.value: "evidence"."classification" <> 'verified_fact' or "evidence"."tx_hash" is not null or "evidence"."block_number" is not null

evidence_heuristic_is_explained.name: evidence_heuristic_is_explained
evidence_heuristic_is_explained.value: "evidence"."classification" <> 'heuristic' or ("evidence"."heuristic_name" is not null and "evidence"."confidence" is not null)
